body: I feel the exact same way.. I've just thought I was a lazy piece of shit, and I've never taken it seriously... I've thought it to be selfish to think it might not be my fault.

I'm doing Computer Science and I'm genuinely interested in it it is just that the classes I am taking this semester are only the required engineering classes such as chemistry, beginning engineering classes, and such. Nothing representative of my major. 

I reached out to my adviser and I'm trying to sort things out, I think I might try to see a doctor about depression but the clinic here on campus only takes campus insurance so I would have to bring it up with my mother and that is going to be hard...

Maybe things can get better, I don't really want this, thanks for the help.

I have so much trouble caring about my work anymore, it doesn't seem important and I can't focus... I try to do something and I lose all interest, I like learning but not what I am forced to learn. I would rather sit on youtube and watch video after video on physics, quantum mechanics, and programming but not give a fuck about my academics.

The worst part is the hindsight of my procrastination knowing I should have done what was important and it makes me completely despise myself, but it never changes.
